correctness.rationale: The one-point extension condition reduces to triangle-free induced subsets; 2-trees are chordal, so these are forests. Every 2-tree admits a degree-two ear and canonical exhaustive edge-attachment recursion. Six-point table is independently checked by two subset algorithms, and its only collision pair has distinct degree sequences. The rooted-edge restricted polynomial is z^2(1+z)^2 in both graphs, yielding the exact all-t polynomial by a bijective split; degree-three vertices distinguish the fan families for all t. Finite checks cover t<=8 but are not used to infer the infinite identity.

value.rationale: A natural cardinality-refined logical type invariant is shown to lose base-reconstruction information already at the exact first boundary within the restricted connected maximal-treewidth-two class, with the only first collision classified and an explicit edge-rooted mechanism producing connected counterexamples at every larger order.
